speaker: hanani-men
text: The remnant who survived the exile are there in the province, in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.
name: Hanani and the men from Judah

speaker: nehemiah
text: O LORD, God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion with those who love Him and keep His commandments,
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to hear the prayer that I, Your servant, now pray before You day and night for Your servants, the Israelites. I confess the sins that we Israelites have committed against You. Both I and my father’s house have sinned.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: We have behaved corruptly against You and have not kept the commandments, statutes, and ordinances that You gave Your servant Moses.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Remember, I pray, the word that You commanded Your servant Moses when You said, ‘If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the nations,
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: but if you return to Me and keep and practice My commandments, then even if your exiles have been banished to the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for My Name.’
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: They are Your servants and Your people. You redeemed them by Your great power and mighty hand.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: O Lord, may Your ear be attentive to my prayer and to the prayers of Your servants who delight to revere Your name. Give Your servant success this day, I pray, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: artaxerxes
text: Why is your face sad, though you are not ill? This could only be sadness of the heart.
name: King Artaxerxes

speaker: nehemiah
text: May the king live forever! Why should I not be sad when the city where my fathers are buried lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?
name: Nehemiah

speaker: artaxerxes
text: What is your request?
name: King Artaxerxes

speaker: nehemiah
text: If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you send me to Judah, to the city where my fathers are buried, so that I may rebuild it.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: artaxerxes
text: How long will your journey take, and when will you return?
name: King Artaxerxes

speaker: nehemiah
text: If it pleases the king, may letters be given to me for the governors west of the Euphrates, so that they will grant me safe passage until I reach Judah.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king’s forest, so that he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel to the temple, for the city wall, and for the house I will occupy.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: You see the trouble we are in. Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned down. Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, so that we will no longer be a disgrace.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: jews
text: Let us start rebuilding,
name: The Jews

speaker: sanballat
text: What is this you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?
name: Sanballat

speaker: nehemiah
text: The God of heaven is the One who will grant us success. We, His servants, will start rebuilding, but you have no portion, right, or claim in Jerusalem.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: sanballat
text: What are these feeble Jews doing? Can they restore the wall by themselves? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they complete it in a day? Can they bring these burnt stones back to life from the mounds of rubble?
name: Sanballat

speaker: tobiah
text: If even a fox were to climb up on what they are building, it would break down their wall of stones!
name: Tobiah the Ammonite

speaker: judah-people
text: The strength of the laborer fails, and there is so much rubble that we will never be able to rebuild the wall.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: enemies
text: Before they know or see a thing, we will come into their midst, kill them, and put an end to the work.
name: Our enemies

speaker: nearby-jews
text: Wherever you turn, they will attack us.
name: The Jews living nearby

speaker: nehemiah
text: Do not be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your homes.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: The work is great and extensive, and we are spread out far from one another along the wall.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Wherever you hear the sound of the horn, rally to us there. Our God will fight for us!
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Let every man and his servant spend the night inside Jerusalem, so that they can stand guard by night and work by day.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: complainers
text: We and our sons and daughters are numerous. We must get grain in order to eat and stay alive.
name: The people

speaker: complainers
text: We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our homes to get grain during the famine.
name: The people

speaker: complainers
text: We have borrowed money to pay the king’s tax on our fields and vineyards.
name: The people

speaker: complainers
text: We and our children are just like our countrymen and their children, yet we are subjecting our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters are already enslaved, but we are powerless to redeem them because our fields and vineyards belong to others.
name: The people

speaker: nehemiah
text: You are exacting usury from your own brothers!
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: We have done our best to buy back our Jewish brothers who were sold to foreigners, but now you are selling your own brothers, that they may be sold back to us!
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: What you are doing is not right. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our foreign enemies?
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: I, as well as my brothers and my servants, have been lending the people money and grain. Please, let us stop this usury.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Please restore to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves, and houses, along with the percentage of the money, grain, new wine, and oil that you have been assessing them.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nobles
text: We will restore it,
name: The nobles and officials

speaker: nobles
text: and will require nothing more from them. We will do as you say.
name: The nobles and officials

speaker: nehemiah
text: May God likewise shake out of His house and possession every man who does not keep this promise. May such a man be shaken out and have nothing!
name: Nehemiah

speaker: assembly
text: Amen,
name: The assembly

speaker: sanballat-geshem
text: Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono.
name: Sanballat and Geshem

speaker: nehemiah
text: I am doing a great work and cannot come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to go down to you?
name: Nehemiah

speaker: sanballat
text: It is reported among the nations—and Geshem agrees—that you and the Jews are plotting to revolt, and this is why you are building the wall. According to these reports, you are to become their king,
name: Sanballat

speaker: sanballat
text: and you have even appointed prophets in Jerusalem to proclaim on your behalf: ‘There is a king in Judah.’ Soon these rumors will reach the ears of the king. So come, let us confer together.
name: Sanballat

speaker: nehemiah
text: There is nothing to these rumors you are spreading; you are inventing them in your own mind.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: enemies
text: Their hands will be weakened in the work, and it will never be finished.
name: Our enemies

speaker: shemaiah
text: Let us meet at the house of God inside the temple. Let us shut the temple doors because they are coming to kill you— by night they are coming to kill you!
name: Shemaiah son of Delaiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Should a man like me run away? Should one like me go into the temple to save his own life? I will not go!
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Do not open the gates of Jerusalem until the sun is hot. While the guards are on duty, keep the doors shut and securely fastened. And appoint the residents of Jerusalem as guards, some at their posts and some at their own homes.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: people
text: Amen, Amen!
name: The people

speaker: nehemiah-ezra-levites
text: This day is holy to the LORD your God. Do not mourn or weep.
name: Nehemiah, Ezra and the Levites

speaker: nehemiah
text: Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: levites
text: Be still, since today is holy. Do not grieve.
name: The Levites

speaker: people
text: Go out to the hill country and bring back branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees, to make booths, as it is written.
name: The people

speaker: levites
text: Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting: Blessed be Your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You alone are the LORD. You created the heavens, the highest heavens with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to all things, and the host of heaven worships You.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You are the LORD, the God who chose Abram, who brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name Abraham.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You found his heart faithful before You, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, of the Jebusites and Girgashites— to give it to his descendants. You have kept Your promise, because You are righteous.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt; You heard their cry at the Red Sea.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, all his officials, and all the people of his land, for You knew they had acted with arrogance against our fathers. You made a name for Yourself that endures to this day.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You divided the sea before them, and they crossed through it on dry ground. You hurled their pursuers into the depths like a stone into raging waters.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You led them with a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way in which they should travel.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven. You gave them just ordinances, true laws, and good statutes and commandments.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You revealed to them Your holy Sabbath and gave them commandments and statutes and laws through Your servant Moses.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: In their hunger You gave them bread from heaven; in their thirst You brought them water from the rock. You told them to go in and possess the land which You had sworn to give them.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: But they and our fathers became arrogant and stiff-necked and did not obey Your commandments.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: They refused to listen and failed to remember the wonders You performed among them. They stiffened their necks and appointed a leader to return them to their bondage in Egypt. But You are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in loving devotion, and You did not forsake them.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: Even when they cast for themselves an image of a calf and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and when they committed terrible blasphemies,
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You in Your great compassion did not forsake them in the wilderness. By day the pillar of cloud never turned away from guiding them on their path; and by the night the pillar of fire illuminated the way they should go.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold Your manna from their mouths, and You gave them water for their thirst.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: For forty years You sustained them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing. Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You gave them kingdoms and peoples and allotted to them every corner of the land. So they took the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and of Og king of Bashan.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You multiplied their descendants like the stars of heaven and brought them to the land You had told their fathers to enter and possess.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: So their descendants went in and possessed the land; You subdued before them the Canaanites dwelling in the land. You delivered into their hands the kings and peoples of the land, to do with them as they wished.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: They captured fortified cities and fertile land and took houses full of all goods, wells already dug, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate and were filled; they grew fat and delighted in Your great goodness.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: But they were disobedient and rebelled against You; they flung Your law behind their backs. They killed Your prophets, who had admonished them to return to You. They committed terrible blasphemies.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: So You delivered them into the hands of enemies who oppressed them, and in their time of distress they cried out to You. From heaven You heard them, and in Your great compassion You gave them deliverers who saved them from the hands of their enemies.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: But as soon as they had rest, they again did evil in Your sight. So You abandoned them to the hands of their enemies, who had dominion over them. When they cried out to You again, You heard from heaven, and You delivered them many times in Your compassion.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You admonished them to turn back to Your law, but they were arrogant and disobeyed Your commandments. They sinned against Your ordinances, by which a man will live if he practices them. They stubbornly shrugged their shoulders; they stiffened their necks and would not obey.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You were patient with them for many years, and Your Spirit admonished them through Your prophets. Yet they would not listen, so You gave them into the hands of the neighboring peoples.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: But in Your great compassion, You did not put an end to them; nor did You forsake them, for You are a gracious and compassionate God.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: So now, our God, the great and mighty and awesome God who keeps His gracious covenant, do not view lightly all the hardship that has come upon us, and upon our kings and leaders, our priests and prophets, our ancestors and all Your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: You are just in all that has befallen us, because You have acted faithfully, while we have acted wickedly.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: Our kings and leaders and priests and fathers did not obey Your law or listen to Your commandments and warnings that You gave them.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: For even while they were in their kingdom, with the abundant goodness that You had given them, and in the spacious and fertile land that You had set before them, they would not serve You or turn from their wicked ways.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: So here we are today as slaves in the land You gave our fathers to enjoy its fruit and goodness— here we are as slaves!
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: Its abundant harvest goes to the kings You have set over us because of our sins. And they rule over our bodies and our livestock as they please. We are in great distress.
name: The Levites

speaker: levites
text: In view of all this, we make a binding agreement, putting it in writing and sealing it with the names of our leaders, Levites, and priests.
name: The Levites

speaker: people
text: The rest of the people—the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, temple servants, and all who had separated themselves from the people of the land to obey the Law of God—along with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand,
name: The people

speaker: people
text: hereby join with their noble brothers and commit themselves with a sworn oath to follow the Law of God given through His servant Moses and to carefully obey all the commandments, ordinances, and statutes of the LORD our Lord.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: We will not give our daughters in marriage to the people of the land, and we will not take their daughters for our sons.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: When the people of the land bring merchandise or any kind of grain to sell on the Sabbath day, we will not buy from them on a Sabbath or holy day. Every seventh year we will let the fields lie fallow, and will cancel every debt.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: We also place ourselves under the obligation to contribute a third of a shekel yearly for the service of the house of our God:
name: The people

speaker: people
text: for the showbread, for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings, for the Sabbath offerings, for the New Moons and appointed feasts, for the holy offerings, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the duties of the house of our God.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: We have cast lots among the priests, Levites, and people for the donation of wood by our families at the appointed times each year. They are to bring it to the house of our God to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the Law.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: We will also bring the firstfruits of our land and of every fruit tree to the house of the LORD year by year.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: And we will bring the firstborn of our sons and our livestock, as it is written in the Law, and will bring the firstborn of our herds and flocks to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: Moreover, we will bring to the priests at the storerooms of the house of our God the firstfruits of our dough, of our grain offerings, of the fruit of all our trees, and of our new wine and oil. A tenth of our produce belongs to the Levites, so that they shall receive tithes in all the towns where we labor.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: A priest of Aaron’s line is to accompany the Levites when they collect the tenth, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of these tithes to the storerooms of the treasury in the house of our God.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: For the Israelites and the Levites are to bring the contributions of grain, new wine, and oil to the storerooms where the articles of the sanctuary are kept and where the ministering priests, the gatekeepers, and the singers stay. Thus we will not neglect the house of our God.
name: The people

speaker: nehemiah
text: Why has the house of God been neglected?
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: What is this evil you are doing—profaning the Sabbath day?
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Did not your forefathers do the same things, so that our God brought all this disaster on us and on this city? And now you are rekindling His wrath against Israel by profaning the Sabbath!
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Why are you camping in front of the wall? If you do it again, I will lay hands on you.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: You must not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters as wives for your sons or for yourselves!
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Did not King Solomon of Israel sin in matters like this? There was not a king like him among many nations, and he was loved by his God, who made him king over all Israel—yet foreign women drew him into sin.
name: Nehemiah

speaker: nehemiah
text: Must we now hear that you too are doing all this terrible evil and acting unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign women?
name: Nehemiah
